subject: Geography
description: Concept pool for UPSC Prelims — Geography > Physical Geography > Climatology. Each concept carries trap_affinity (which trap IDs historically apply), links_to (cross-concept interlinkages for hard A/R questions), and ca_trigger_types (what current affairs events activate this concept as a UPSC question).
